name: Vinnin Square Plaza
summary: Vinnin Square Plaza is a fully-leased 63,975 square foot shopping center located on Route 1A in Swampscott, Massachusetts, featuring a diverse mix of national, regional, and local tenants. Managed by Kimco Realty, the property serves the affluent North Shore Boston market with excellent accessibility and ample parking.
demographics: Vinnin Square Plaza serves an affluent suburban Boston market with a 1-mile radius median household income of $121,266 and average household income of $172,121. The trade area encompasses approximately 13,366 residents within one mile, expanding to over 700,000 within ten miles, with strong daytime populations supporting retail activity. The demographic profile features upper-middle-class families and professionals with high per capita incomes of $69,625, indicating strong purchasing power and preference for quality national and regional retailers.
description: Vinnin Square Plaza is a well-established shopping center strategically located on Route 1A in the Vinnin Square sub-market of Swampscott, Massachusetts, serving the affluent North Shore Boston metropolitan area. This 63,975 square foot retail destination offers a carefully curated mix of national, regional, and local tenants that cater to the sophisticated needs of the surrounding community. The property benefits from excellent accessibility along a major thoroughfare and provides ample parking with a ratio of 5.55 spaces per 1,000 square feet, ensuring convenience for shoppers. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Vinnin Square Plaza maintains high occupancy standards and is currently fully leased, reflecting strong tenant demand and market confidence. The center's location in the Boston-Cambridge-Newton metro area positions it within one of the nation's most economically vibrant markets, serving households with a median income exceeding $121,000 within a one-mile radius.
